public.title: Contiguous Array
public.description: Return the maximum length of a contiguous subarray containing equally many 0s and 1s. Return 0 if none exists. There are 0 to 1000 values, each 0 or 1.
hints: Treat 0 as -1 and find the farthest equal prefix balances.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Equal prefix balances enclose a balanced subarray. Store the earliest index for each balance to maximize length. Expected O(n) time.
